translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Markus
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I MARKUS

content: Yesus nilaboti tia adat na Yerusalem
Sarataa i Yesus tia murit-Na montorumpakimo Yerusalem, karani'mo Betfage tia Betania men na Buu'na Zaitun, ai Yesus nomosuu'mo murit-Na rurua',

ka' nomotoo tae-Na, “Rae' na kampung katu'u men torumpakionta. Taka intu'u kodi' i kuu bo liuliu mungurumpaki sa'angu' keledai rundara nitoongkon, men sianpo ia toolakiti mian. Alaka' kakai a kokootna ka' wawa tu'umari.
Ka' too isian mian mimikirawar na ko'omuu taena, ‘Nongko'upa i kuu se' mangkakai kokootna keledai kanono'?’ bantilkon inta', ‘Tumpu mamaraluui. Ka' sian maalin daa ule'konon-Namo ka'ita.’ ”
Raaya'a nomae'mo ka' nungurumpaki keledai rundara nitoongkon na aropna laigan na soripi'na salan, kasi ia kakai i raaya'a.
Isian toropii mian indo'o potokerer nimikirawar na ko'ona i raaya'a, taena, “Nongko'upa i kuu se' mangkakai kokootna keledai kanono'?”
Kasi ia simbati i raaya'a koi men Ia potookon i Yesus. Mbaka' i raaya'a ia patalaimo mian.
Kasi i raaya'a nangawawa keledai iya'a mbaatu'u ni Yesus. Taka intu'u ia latasimo i raaya'a a sengke'na keledai iya'a tia jubana, kasi ia lakiti i Yesus.
Biai' a mian nanggampalkon bokukumna i raaya'a na salan, ka' isian mian men nangala' na ale' panga' morio' men roonanaan ka' nendeer na salan.
Giigii' mian men potorae', mau men na olukon ka' men na komburi', mangkakaro'kon taena,

content.text: Barakaatan i Ia men taka ia pokau Tumpu!
Barakaatan a Batomundo'an-Na ini'imari men batomundo'an ni Daud minti'inta!
Tunde' a Alaata'ala men na ko'alayo'an.”

content: Taka na Yerusalem i Yesus ninsoopmo na Laiganna Alaata'ala. Na lalomna Ia lealokonmo ka' ninasai wiwi'na. Kasee ka' boomo malom, ia nomae'mo na Betania tia sompulo' rua' murit-Na.
Yesus nantadeankon kau ara kada' bi pate
Koi liilana, tempona ari Yesus namarereimo Betania, Yesus nopoosurimo nololu.

Na oloapo ia nontoa'i kau ara koi kantu'u, marioompong a roonana. Ia rae'imo a kau ara iya'a toodaa woo'an, kasee taka intu'u i Ia, Ia sian nungurumpaki woo'na, tongko' roonana a biai', gause sianpo tempona miwoo'.
Mbaka' i Yesus nomorobu na kau iya'a tae-Na, “Muntumbei koini'i sa'angu'po mian sianmo mangkaan woo'om pataka manau'.” Giigii' murit-Na nongorongor.
Yesus numbuse'i mian men mobaluk na Laiganna Alaata'ala
Kasi taka a ari Yesus na Yerusalem. Tongko' ninsoop i Yesus na Laiganna Alaata'ala, Ia numbuse'imo mian biai' men ba'ili ka' men mobalu-baluk indo'o na tolodona Laiganna Alaata'ala.
Meja'na mian men totolosi doi'
ka' bangkona mian men mobaluk marampatii Ia tua-tua'kon.
Ia sianmo namatalai mian men mobaluk mangawawa upana lumiu na tolodona Laiganna Alaata'ala.

Kasi i Yesus nimisiso' ka' nambantili i raaya'a, tae-Na, “Taasi' nipokotulismo na Alkitaap, ‘Laigan-Ku tio ngaanon laigan bo basambayanganna mianna longkop tano'? Kasee kuu wawaumo bo dodongoanna mian puraga!’ ”

Sarataa tanaasna imam tia wawa ukum Torat nongorongor upa men ia wawau i Yesus, raaya'a nansarakmo akal kada' mampapatei i Ia. Raaya'a uga' layaonkon i Yesus gause biai' a mian men koporean upa men pisiso'konon-Na.
Guntumalommo Yesus tia murit-Na namarereimo kota iya'a.
Yesus nimisiso'kon kau ara men nokangkungmo
Koi liilana ma'ulop tempo i raaya'a nolumiu, ia piile' i raaya'a a kau ara iya'a nokangkungmo tia waka-wakatna.
Mbaka' notonginau'mo i Petrus upa men ia ngaan i Yesus koi rimberi'na. Ia nobapikirawarmo taena, “Guru, piile'! Kau ara men Kuu tadeankon, nokangkungmo.”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Parasayamo na Alaata'ala.

Imamat a men taeng-Ku', ka' uga' bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' ime a momosuu' buu'na kani'i, taena, ‘Bi ko'akit ka' bi tombalo' i koo na tobui,’ asar noana amo' babata ka' parasaya se' bo sida a men ngaanonna, mbaka' men koiya'a bo sida na ko'ona.
Mbali' iya'a bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' upa a men pa'ase'onmuu na sambayangmuu, parasaya inono' se' Alaata'ala noko pantaraimo upa men kuu pa'ase', mbaka' i kuu bo mangalabot.
Kalu i kuu kumukerer sambayang, kasee noamuu kokoo'ankon mian gause i ia nampapolosi noamuu, ampuni kutung a mian iya'a, kada' Tamamuu men na surugaa mangampuni i kuu.
[Kalu i kuu sian mangampuni sala'na mian, mbaka' Tamamuu men na surugaa uga' sian mangampuni sala'muu.]”
Moomoola'na Yahudi nimikirawar ni Yesus kuasa-Na
Ai Yesus tia murit-Na notakamo soosoodo na Yerusalem. Rae-rae' i Yesus na tolodona Laiganna Alaata'ala taka a toropii tanaasna imam, wawa ukum Torat ka' motu-motu'a nantaankon i Ia.
Raaya'a nimikirawar, taena, “Upa a pimpu'uaan nangawawau men koiya'a? Ka' ime a nantarai i Koo kuasa mbali' nangawawau giigii' iya'a?”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Yaku' uga isian upa bo pikirawaron-Ku na ko'omuu. Alaka' simbati kada' bantilkonon-Ku i kuu se' kuasa ni ime mbali' daa i Yaku' mangawawau koiya'a.
Alaata'ala kabai mian a nantarai i Yohanes kuasa bo pansarani mian? Koi upa i kuu?”

Tanaasna imam ka' motu-motu'a na Yahudi nopootunduniimo raaraaya'ana, taena, “Kalu kita mangaan, ‘Kuasana ringkat na Alaata'ala,’ mbaka' simbation-Na, ‘Nongko'upa i kuu se' kosian mamarasaya upa men taeni Yohanes?’
Kasee mare-marepanapo kalu simbationta, ‘Kuasana ringkat na mian.’ Kita bo komaso'kononna mian biai' gause pimiile'na mian giigii' se' i Yohanes tuutuu' sa'angu' nabii.”
Mbaka' ia simbati i raaya'a, “Sian inti'ionmai.” Taeni Yesus, “Kalu koiya'a, Yaku' uga' sian mambantilkon na ko'omuu se' kuasa ni ime bo pimpu'uan-Ku mangawawau koiya'a.”

footnotes.text: tolodona Laiganna Alaata'ala: Tolodo iya'a bo basambayanganna mian men taasi' Yahudi. Kasee ia pakemo i raaya'a bo pobalukanna.

totolosi doi': Giigii' mian men taka na Yerusalem men taasi'po samba Yahudi see sambayang na Laiganna Alaata'ala tiodaa mombolosi doi'na i raaya'a kada' sida bo pambayar pajak na Laiganna Alaata'ala ka' bo pingili kurbaan.
